offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures turf care, irrigation, underground construction, and snow and ice control equipment for contractors, golf courses, municipalities, and other professional customers. It also sells lawn, garden, and snow removal equipment to homeowners through dealers, retailers, and online stores.

primary_products.value: commercial turf and landscape equipment; golf, landscape, and agricultural irrigation systems; underground construction and compact equipment; snow and ice control equipment; residential lawn and garden equipment

primary_services.value: paid technical support plans for golf course irrigation systems

customer_segment.value: B2B: Golf courses, landscape contractors, growers, utility contractors, equipment rental companies, and snow removal contractors; B2C: Homeowners maintaining lawns, gardens, and driveways; B2G: Municipal parks departments and public works agencies

end_markets.value: golf and sports turf; commercial landscaping and grounds maintenance; underground utility construction; agriculture; residential lawn, garden, and snow care

revenue_model.value: product sales: Equipment, irrigation systems, attachments, and replacement parts; subscription: Ongoing technical support for golf course irrigation systems

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds equipment and irrigation systems from sourced materials and components for professional users and homeowners; service provider: Uses irrigation system expertise to provide paid technical support to golf course operators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Turf care, irrigation, underground construction, snow and ice control, and residential lawn and garden equipment

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Independent outdoor power equipment dealers and specialist irrigation and construction equipment distributors; third-party retail: Home improvement chains, hardware stores, and mass-market retailers; direct sales: Selected commercial and government accounts; online: Company and retailer websites selling equipment, accessories, and parts
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales; online
